incident-bot: PAGER -> GPU-serving: kvcache error rate spike across primary pool (>5%) — alert 3min ago, incidents.redwood/internal/3610004321 :rotating_light:
Maria G.: taking primary for late window, jumping in now. preliminary: latency up ~300ms p95, some customers seeing 5xx on generation path. tagging @Aj for secondary.
Aj Patel: ack, on secondary. any immediate mitigations we want to run?
Maria G.: first pass — check kvcache hit/miss + pod restarts. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cache-degradation (see section "fast recovery"). quick checks:
```
# check pods
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=gpu-serving
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/gpu-serving --tail=200 | jq '.level,.msg' | grep kvcache
```
Leo K: if misses are high, consider temporary fallback to smaller model variant and disable per-request caching invalidation. costy but buys time.
Sophia R: FYI APAC oncall is out (OOO), coverage gap there if we need cross-zone failover. Maria, can you /cc infra escalation if we promote fallback?
Maria G.: noted — primary: Maria (me), secondary: Aj. escalation path: if >10% customer impact or >15m no improvement, page SRE lead @Leo and infra oncall via #incidents-escalation.
oncall-bot: Reminder: update duty status when handing off (use `/oncall handoff`)
ops-svcs: dashboards: https://dashboards.redwood/internal/kvcache -> query `sum(rate(kvcache_errors[1m])) by (pool)` shows spike on primary-gpu-2. also see per-customer error tags.
Aj Patel: I'll tail the logs and stand by to run restart on your go. if you want me to roll one node now, say the word.
Maria G.: rolling one replica now (graceful): `kubectl rollout restart deployment/gpu-serving -n inference --field-selector spec.nodeName=gpu-node-12` — will monitor.
Maria G.: short handoff checklist for whoever takes bridge: 1) check dashboards + logs 2) follow fast-recovery section of runbook 3) if miss rate >4% after restart, flip to fallback variant and open infra escalation 4) annotate incident with customer list (use `incident-template/kvcache-impact`) :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident acknowledged, status -> investigating. suppressed noisy alerts for 10m to reduce churn.
Leo K: if restart doesn't reduce error rate within 5m, be ready to promote read-only cache warming (run cache-warm script) — I'll prepare the job.
Maria G.: handing bridge to Leo in ~20m unless we resolve. Aj will remain secondary. leaving pointers in the thread and runbook fragment attached. ping me @Maria if anything spikes.
Sophia R.: thanks — capturing APAC gap in ticket. if we need a long-lived fallback, we should also flag billing/product for customer messaging.
Maria G.: current status: restart started, p95 improving slightly. will post updates in thread. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
